claims.claim: Across v1 and v2, the Delta model retains the same 80 percent C0 accuracy.

evidence.quote: Main result. Under calibration mode C0, the fictional Delta model attains 80 percent accuracy.
Main result. Under calibration mode C0, the fictional Delta model attains 82 percent accuracy; v2 replaces the earlier 80 percent value.

claims.rationale: SYNTHETIC: v1 directly states 80 percent for C0, while v2 explicitly replaces it with 82 percent for C0. The version difference is retained in parallel; newer v2 is not treated as automatically authoritative. Verdict applies only to version_scope=doc-v1, doc-v2; no version pooling.

claims.claim: With optional H1 enabled and temperature fixed at 10 degrees, Delta attains 90 percent accuracy.

evidence.quote: Only when the optional high-memory flag H1 is enabled and the temperature is fixed at 10 degrees, the fictional Delta model attains 90 percent accuracy.
evidence.locator: supplement S2, S-Table 1, local supplement page S-1

claims.rationale: SYNTHETIC: the exact S2 supplement statement supports the 90 percent result only under both H1 and fixed 10-degree conditions. No main-document page or C0 condition is inherited. Verdict applies only to version_scope=doc-supplement-s2; no version pooling.
claims.condition: H1 enabled AND temperature fixed at 10 degrees
